mutations.name: Lean Muscle
mutations.branch_role: Mobility mutation: changes range, exits, and route timing without solving impact.
mutations.weakness: If pinned, the lighter body has less health margin.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Enter or leave striking distance before a slower body can reset its stance.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Cross exposed corridors, closing doors, and collapsing tissue before the room finishes reacting.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Outrun a route pattern long enough to break a hunter's prediction.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes harder to pin but easier to injure when caught.

mutations.name: Bigger Scythe
mutations.branch_role: Force mutation: opens hard cutting branches and makes recovery windows visible.
mutations.weakness: Heavy commitment slows first response and advertises violence.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Commit to a heavy cut that can sever armor, limbs, cords, or a blocking predator line.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Hack through thick membranes, bone ropes, and sealed growths that smaller tools cannot open.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Cut a trophy mark that makes some rivals recognize Hymn as a dangerous claimant.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn chooses force that wins space but leaves recovery windows.

mutations.name: Spring Sinew
mutations.branch_role: Opening-tempo mutation: wins the first beat, then creates recovery trouble.
mutations.weakness: After the burst, Hymn moves worse until the body unloads the strain.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Explode into the first beat of an exchange before a predator can finish reading her weight.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Leap broken seams, snap loose from tendons, or cross a closing gap in one committed burst.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Hold still long enough to store a spring-step that opens a quiet ambush or escape route.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a body built around first commitment and painful recovery.

mutations.name: Bone Plates
mutations.description: 5 armor at start of battle. Damage reduced by 1.
mutations.branch_role: Guard mutation: lets Hymn hold contact or crossing pressure that would otherwise force retreat.
mutations.weakness: Armor patterns make her easier for heavy systems and wardens to classify.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Take a hit while closing, pinning, or holding a dangerous line.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Brace under falling teeth, hot resin, pressure gates, and crushing room motions.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Present plate patterns that certain wardens read as authorized body armor.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes harder to wound and easier for heavy systems to classify.

mutations.name: Spiked Armor
mutations.branch_role: Close-pressure mutation: makes holds and bites costly but leaves obvious puncture evidence.
mutations.weakness: The body becomes hard to hide, comfort, carry, or pass as harmless.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Make grapples, bites, and close-range pressure costly for enemies.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Hook into soft walls, climb living ladders, or keep a closing mouth from sealing cleanly.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Leave recognizable puncture signatures that frighten lesser predators and alert smarter ones.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes unsafe to hold and difficult to hide.

mutations.name: Rotkill Liver
mutations.description: Endure fouled pools, rotkill wash, and bad fluid. Sturdier blood, slower first strike.
mutations.branch_role: Tolerance mutation: turns hostile fluid into route and disguise material.
mutations.weakness: Cleaner systems and first-strike exchanges read the altered blood poorly.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Stay functional when venom, rotwash, or fouled blood would slow another body.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Drink, wade, or breathe through contaminated rooms that would otherwise force retreat.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Use bad fluid as a disguise when predators track clean blood.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a body that can live where cleaner bodies fail.

mutations.name: Scar Reader
mutations.description: Read old cuts, route marks, and wound-script before the room finishes lying.
mutations.branch_role: Reading mutation: reveals prior damage, failed guards, and route history before commitment.
mutations.weakness: The body can hesitate around damage patterns that faster choices would ignore.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Read old wound angles and predict where an enemy's guard has failed before.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Decode route cuts, surgical marks, and old passage scars before following them.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Recognize a rival or predecessor by the way their wounds changed the room.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a reader of damage and implied history.

mutations.name: Nurse Scent Gland
mutations.description: Smell less like prey to larvae, hatchlings, and weak symbiotes. Hunters can learn the scent.
mutations.branch_role: Scent mutation: delays weak life and nursery alarms while teaching hunters a repeatable smell.
mutations.weakness: Predators that learn the nurse-scent can track or bait it later.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Make weaker organisms hesitate, misclassify her, or delay their first bite.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Approach larvae, hatchlings, symbiotes, and nurseries without waking every alarm.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Pass as caretaker-scent in rooms that punish obvious predators.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes less prey-like to some bodies and more legible to hunters that learn the scent.

mutations.name: Toll Tongue
mutations.description: Bargain with mouths, ledgers, and resin debt before the price becomes teeth.
mutations.branch_role: Negotiation mutation: makes hunger and ledgers answer before biting.
mutations.weakness: Debt systems remember a body willing to speak their language.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Answer mouth-organs and debt beasts before their bite becomes the only language.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Negotiate tolls, ledgers, ration mouths, and exchange organs with less immediate blood.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Talk a hostile mouth into recognizing someone else's unpaid mark.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a body that can bargain with hunger, which makes hunger remember her.

mutations.name: False Pulse
mutations.description: Lie to tally organs, measuring rings, and anything that opens a fight by reading you.
mutations.branch_role: Identity mutation: spoofs body readers and rank tests at a health margin cost.
mutations.weakness: The false rhythm weakens the body and can be caught by systems that test twice.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Confuse enemies that open with pulse-reading, rank testing, or first-strike measurement.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Fool tally organs, authority rings, and route locks that sort bodies by rhythm.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Imitate an old authorized pulse long enough to enter a forbidden progression threshold.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a practiced liar to systems that read the body as proof.

mutations.name: Wound Lock
mutations.description: Clamp red splits, open cuts, and pressure leaks long enough to pass through them.
mutations.branch_role: Wound-control mutation: treats cuts, leaks, and red doors as held positions.
mutations.weakness: The clamping body moves slower and invites rooms to use wounds as interfaces.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Clamp a bleeding opening or enemy-made cut long enough to stay in the exchange.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Seal red splits, leaking doors, pressure seams, and wounded passages while crossing them.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Hold another body's wound open or closed as a bargaining tool.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a body that treats wounds as locks, not only injuries.

mutations.name: Clot-Step Feet
mutations.description: Cross brittle marrow, egg fields, and sleeping floors without waking every nerve.
mutations.branch_role: Quiet-route mutation: changes floor, egg, and patrol pressure at the cost of cutting force.
mutations.weakness: The lighter gait weakens direct damage and can be patterned by route systems.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Shift weight quietly to enter, retreat, or circle without waking a strike pocket.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Cross brittle marrow, egg fields, and sleeping floors without announcing every step.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Leave false weight patterns that make route systems prepare for a smaller body.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a lighter-footed predator with weaker cutting force.

mutations.name: Larder Gut
mutations.description: Digest unsafe ration matter, eggs, and grub credit before it turns into debt.
mutations.branch_role: Scarcity mutation: converts unsafe food pressure into strength or social proof.
mutations.weakness: Filthy economies and scavenger organisms start treating Hymn as one of theirs.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Stay fed through a long fight by converting unsafe matter that would sicken a cleaner gut.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Digest ration matter, eggs, grubs, and spoiled offerings without immediate collapse.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Turn another room's waste into proof of belonging among scavenger organisms.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes less dependent on clean food and more acceptable to filthy economies.

mutations.name: Split Shed
mutations.description: Leave a skin, scent, or heat trace behind when retreating or breaking a route pattern.
mutations.branch_role: Escape mutation: breaks contact or route prediction by abandoning part of the self.
mutations.weakness: Discarded pieces can be counted, eaten, accepted as payment, or used as evidence.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Break contact by leaving skin, scent, heat, or a false grab-point in the enemy's hold.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Shed a trace at forks, traps, tolls, and hunter-marked rooms to confuse route memory.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Plant a discarded self that another organism accepts as payment, proof, or prey.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes a body that can abandon pieces of identity to keep moving.

mutations.name: Anchor Rib
mutations.description: Hold position against current, launch pressure, ferry pull, and forced movement.
mutations.branch_role: Position mutation: resists forced movement and turns the body into a living stake.
mutations.weakness: The body becomes slower to choose flight and easier to route around.
mutations.in_encounter_use: Hold ground against charges, pulls, ferries, current, and forced repositioning.
mutations.out_of_encounter_use: Anchor inside launch bores, flooding harbors, pressure locks, and moving floors.
mutations.surprising_second_use: Serve as a living stake that lets another body, bridge, or route hold position.
mutations.progression_identity: Hymn becomes harder to move and slower to choose flight.
